description: Lists Vogue Paris issues (1920-1954) by year, month or date range, each with its date, page count and a link to read it on https://vogue-paris.vercel.app. With no filters it returns how many issues each year holds. images_available is true for issues from 1930 and earlier (US public domain). Examples: {"year": 1925}; {"from": "1926-03-01", "to": "1926-06-30"}; {"month": 12}.

month.description: Month of the year, 1-12, across all years
